description: Logs a phone call the team made outside the phone system (a cell phone, a desk phone) on a contact, as the contact pane's Log a call does. outcome: answered (someone picked up), no_answer, or voicemail (you left one). Optional note (what was said) and at (ISO time the call happened; now when left out, never in the future). The call joins the contact's history and moves their Lead status: an answered call reads In discussion; no answer or a voicemail, with nothing back from them, reads Contacted (a quote, a booking or a status a person set still wins). The answer carries leadStatus, where they stand now. Calls made through the connected phone system are recorded already; do not log those. Nothing is sent. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying; a repeat returns the original call.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: log_call
title: Log a call to a contact
